item.statement: Uncatalogued risk: negative shifts must resolve by floor-modulo, not C remainder or normalized-coordinate rounding; padded pitch cells must not leak into the logical result.

plans.objective: Detect negative-shift modulo-convention errors and padding leakage.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the cases on Ascend 950PR, and capture logical and padded output.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff logical outputs match the floor-mod oracle bitwise (for example -1 maps to width-1/height-1) and padding sentinels remain unchanged.
plans.setup: Run width=17, height=13, pitch=23 with shiftX=-1, shiftY=-1 and with shiftX=-width-2, shiftY=-height-3; pre-fill padding with sentinels; compute floor-mod oracle.
